_comment: Org label taxonomy (mirrors swarm-routing/AntHocNet ADR-0013). Applied to a repo by .github/workflows/sync-labels.yml; the shared release:vX.Y.Z labels serve each repo's own ladder (its docs/roadmap.md); a repo with a longer ladder (AntHocNet) keeps its own release labels.

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Type: defect, regression or wrong result

labels.name: enhancement
labels.description: Type: new mechanism or capability

labels.name: chore
labels.description: Type: mechanical maintenance (format, CI, packaging)

labels.name: documentation
labels.description: Type: docs only

labels.name: verification
labels.description: Type: benchmark re-run / noise confirmation

labels.name: question
labels.description: Usage or behaviour question

labels.name: epic
labels.description: Umbrella issue; children are sub-issues

labels.name: handoff
labels.description: Work in flight handed to the next session

labels.name: good first issue
labels.description: Contributor: small, well-scoped, a good start for a newcomer

labels.name: help wanted
labels.description: Contributor: outside help is welcome on this issue

labels.name: protocol
labels.description: Area: a protocol's core/ algorithm

labels.name: adapter
labels.description: Area: ns-3 translation layer

labels.name: ns3
labels.description: Area: ns-3 build, versions, contrib module

labels.name: benchmark
labels.description: Area: arenas, harness, ns3-tool, datasets

labels.name: observability
labels.description: Area: ##RUN##/##BENCH##/##DIAG## lines, probes, traces

labels.name: packaging
labels.description: Area: images, reusable workflows, install, release

labels.name: learn-site
labels.description: Area: the Colony Arena site and games

labels.name: literature
labels.description: Area: papers, fidelity notes, equation Rosetta Stones

labels.name: model:haiku-4.5
labels.description: Recommended model: mechanical / chore

labels.name: model:sonnet-5
labels.description: Recommended model: well-specified plumbing, tooling, docs

labels.name: model:opus-4.8
labels.description: Recommended model: protocol semantics, root cause, CI-validated adapter work

labels.name: model:fable-5
labels.description: Recommended model: architectural / greenfield

labels.name: priority:P1
labels.description: Fix first: regression or blocker that invalidates numbers

labels.name: priority:P2
labels.description: Gates publishing a result or enabling a gated feature

labels.name: priority:P3
labels.description: Valuable, not blocking

labels.name: release:v0.1.0
labels.description: Gated by this repository's v0.1.0 release (its docs/roadmap.md)

labels.description: Gated by this repository's v0.2.0 release (its docs/roadmap.md)
